liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Saint Stephen** (2 reviews): Standout performance with tight, effortless, and trippy feel; Listener hooked within seven minutes, calling it the best show they've heard [14][15]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Spectacular performance with flawless sound quality and Jerry driving the band [13]
- **Dancing In The Street** (1 review): Phil's bass sounds like Flea from Red Hot Chili Peppers [13]

## The recordings

- **gd76-06-09.hopkins.vernon.5982.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 26 songs; 213 min; rated 3.85/5 by 13 [1]
- **gd1976-06-09.sbd.miller.95399.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 23 songs; 197 min; rated 4.52/5 by 23 [3]
- **gd1976-06-09.156991.mtx.seamons.ht141.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 193 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [4]
- **gd1976-06-09.152189.s1-s2p.aud.petrunis.flac2448**: audience recording; 18 songs; 146 min [7]
- **gd76-06-09.set2-sbd.gardner.5426.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 16 songs; 101 min; rated 4.88/5 by 40 [8]. Said about its sound: Crystal clear quality with audience noise complementing the show's feel [12]
- **gd76-06-09.set1-sbd.cotsman.12382.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 10 songs; 69 min; rated 4/5 by 5 [10]. Said about its sound: Phil's bass and piano have nice levels after minor enhancement [19]

## Around the show

- Audience patch captures tiny hall feel, coughs, and eruption into Saint Stephen [22]
- Favorite of the four Boston Music Hall shows and one of the best from 1976 [14]
- Quality is slightly underneath the June 3rd offering but still stellar [17]
- Changed listener's mind about 1976 shows, comparable to 6-29 Chicago [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd76-06-09.hopkins.vernon.5982.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Steve Hopkins; source: Audience Recording: Sony ECM 99a stereo mic [1]. Also: Transferred from master cassettes to DAT by Dave Minor, then CDR by Dave Handrich [1]
- **gd1976-06-09.sbd.miller.95399.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Set 1: SBD -> Master Cassette -> CD, Set 2: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat -> Sonic Solutions -> CD [3]. Also: Pitch corrected with help from Joe B. Jones using Sony ECM-99A source [3]
- **gd1976-06-09.156991.mtx.seamons.ht141.flac16**: source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC > AIFF > Final Cut > Soundtrack Pro > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT w/meta-tagging) [4]. Also: First set from SBD master cassette; second set from master reel source [4]
- **gd1976-06-09.152189.s1-s2p.aud.petrunis.flac2448**: taped by Concert recording by Rich Petrunis.; transferred by Transferred by Andrew F. 04/2021; source: Mono Sony hand-held recorder (model unknown) > TDK SD C90 & C120 (normal bias). [7]. Also: Big chunk of second set missing due to tech glitch; tapes from Petrunis [7]
- **gd76-06-09.set2-sbd.gardner.5426.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [8]
- **gd76-06-09.set1-sbd.cotsman.12382.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [10]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Snooky Flowers Grateful Dead: [1976-06-09 Boston Music Hall, Boston, MA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1976-06-09-boston-music-hall-boston-ma-usa/) [24]
